slides.transcript:
What is thefacebook.com?

thefacebook.com is an expanding online directory that connects students, alumni, faculty and staff through social networks at colleges and universities. This online directory allows for user connections on the basis of friendship, courses and social networks (including intra and inter-school networks), and has a built-in messaging system.
slides.summary: This slide introduces the product offering as an online directory connecting college and university communities through social networks, friendship, courses, and messaging.
key_points: Expanding online directory connecting students, alumni, faculty, and staff
Operates through social networks at colleges and universities
Allows user connections based on friendship, courses, and social networks
Includes intra and inter-school networks
Features a built-in messaging system

slides.transcript:
User Profile

Each thefacebook.com user maintains and updates a profile that includes:

• Contact information
• Personal information: relationship status and procurement, political views, clubs, jobs and favourite music, books, movies and quote.
• Course information: the site has a built-in database of school courses and concentrations and automatically builds a user's class schedule.
• Picture
slides.summary: This slide outlines the core user profile features of thefacebook.com, detailing the types of personal, contact, and academic information maintained by users. It demonstrates the product's functionality in organizing user data and automatically building class schedules from a built-in course database.
key_points: Users maintain and update a personal profile
Profiles include contact and personal information such as relationship status and procurement, political views, clubs, jobs, and favorites
Profiles include course information linked to a built-in database of school courses and concentrations
The site automatically builds a user's class schedule
Profiles include a picture

slides.transcript: Additionally, thefacebook.com automatically adds to each user profile links to school news articles that refer to the user, the last user-away message in the AIM system and the last user access location (the site has a built-in database of school dormitories and halls).
slides.summary: This slide highlights key product features and automated profile enhancements, demonstrating integration with external communication systems and campus data to enrich user profiles.
key_points: Automatically adds links to school news articles referring to the user on each user profile
Integrates the last user-away message in the AIM system
Displays the last user access location
Utilizes a built-in database of school dormitories and halls

slides.transcript:
Social Networking
Intra-School Networking

Each thefacebook.com user can browse their school's social network through the following mediums:

1. Social Net: Displays ten random people from the user's school
2. Course Roasters: Displays all students enrolled in any given courses
3. Advanced Search Engine: Allows for search on every user profile parameter

Additionally, each user can add friendship list to their profile, pending second-source verification of friendship status.
Thefacebook.com automatically adds to each profile a visualization of their friendship network and an indication of the user's connection to viewers of their profile (i.e., friends, friend's friends).
slides.summary: This slide outlines the core features of the intra-school social networking product, including user browsing mediums such as a social net, course roasters, and an advanced search engine. It also describes the friendship list functionality, verification process, and network visualization features.
key_points: Social Net displays ten random people from the user's school
Course Roasters displays all students enrolled in any given courses
Advanced Search Engine allows for search on every user profile parameter
Friendship lists require pending second-source verification of friendship status
Profiles automatically feature a visualization of the friendship network and connection indications to viewers

slides.transcript:
Intra-School Networking

Each user can also browse the social network of other schools through the global search function. Each user can add a friendship list for each school in thefacebook.com network
slides.summary: This slide outlines the product's intra-school networking capabilities, allowing users to browse other schools' social networks via global search and maintain friendship lists across the thefacebook.com network.
key_points: Users can browse the social network of other schools using a global search function
Users can add a friendship list for each school in the thefacebook.com network

slides.transcript:
Our audience

The College Addiction

There are 15 million college students in the United States. With an estimated purchasing power that exceeds $85 billion, college students have money in their pockets for your services and products. This year they will spend $21 billion on restaurants and food, $9 billion on automobiles, $5 billion on clothes, $4 billion on phones and $46 billion on other amenities. College students are also active job seekers.
slides.summary: This slide defines the target customer demographic as the 15 million college students in the United States. It outlines their total purchasing power and spending breakdown across various categories, highlighting them as a lucrative market for services, products, and employment.

Advertisement

thefacebook.com website allows your company to reach college students, alumni, faculty and staff at the library, their work, home or dorm rooms.

You can target users using traditional horizontal/vertical banners, links and other more contextual ad placements. We will help you identify the most effective placements to reach the goals of your campaign.
